_source: Git-tracked fallback for curia-research-daily and curia-suggestion-review's daily briefing (see docs/data/pending-review-queue.json's own note for the full diagnosis — the Artifact tool's write_db is unreachable from this job's headless execution environment, read_db is fine). Each run appends one entry here instead of writing directly to Curia Command's `briefings` collection; synced in from a human or an interactive session during a normal check-in. `synced` flips to true once it's landed in the portal.

entries.title: 10 promoted, 0 rejected, 3 closures flagged for review
entries.summary: All 10 pending candidates in venue-suggestions.json (Northern Quarter, Ancoats, Altrincham, Knutsford, Mobberley, Chinatown, and two in Deansgate, Spinningfields, Hale) independently re-verified and promoted straight into venues.json, with real petFriendly/dietaryOptions researched for each. No Curia Command decisions were waiting to apply this run. The closure audit's rotating slice caught King Street Kitchen (Knutsford) as genuinely closed, and a follow-up on two closure signals left open since 2026-09-04 (Riva Bar & Restaurant, Hale; The Yard, Alderley Edge) corroborated both — all three sent to pending-review-queue.json as remove_venue candidates rather than auto-removed.

entries.title: 10 venues + 1 district promoted, 1 sent for review, 0 rejected, 1 closure flagged
entries.summary: 10 of the 11 pending candidates in venue-suggestions.json (four in Didsbury including the district's first venues, two in Chorlton, plus Prestbury, Knutsford, Altrincham and Alderley Edge) and the sole pending district candidate (Stockport's Underbanks quarter, a genuine new Manchester-metro district) independently re-verified and promoted, with real petFriendly/dietaryOptions researched for each venue. No Curia Command decisions were waiting to apply this run (pending_review collection was empty). Fire Station Social Cucina (Alderley Edge) was re-checked specifically for a rumoured third site — none found — and stays pending, already sitting in pending-review-queue.json since 2026-09-06. Two factual corrections surfaced during re-verification and were folded into the promoted copy: Lime Tree in fact has a second site in Bollington (still promoted, small personally-run pair, not a chain), and Casa de Moor's Heaton Moor sibling has rebranded to 'Casa De Casa' since it was first researched (reason text updated). The closure audit's rotating slice caught Les Deux Pizza Bar (Alderley Edge) showing as closed on its own Deliveroo listing — sent to pending-review-queue.json rather than auto-removed; the other four in the slice (The Blind Pig, InHale Yoga, Lions Den, Australasia) re-confirmed still trading.
